lines.en: I drift forward above the ground.
My steps make no sound.
Shorter now, but the pressure hasn't shrunk.
Ki carries me; no need to walk.
This body feels very light.
One burst takes me far.
Turning is easier in the air.
I fly half a circle around you.
Wind presses my clothes to me.
This speed feels right.
I step on invisible ground.
I hover, feet off the ground.
Ki circles around me.

lines.zh: 这身体使不上全身力气。
lines.en: This body can't bring out all my strength.
I'm evening out my breath.
My hair lifts in the aura.
I look up at the sky.
It's not time to transform yet.
I'm working out a new approach.
There's an odd smell in the air.
A tendon on my hand twitches.
Even standing still I seem to move.
The ki in this area is muddled.
I'm waiting for this body to adjust.
The quiet feels strange.

lines.zh: 你这身高跟我差不多了。
lines.en: You're about my height now.
I'm still adjusting to this body.
You hide your ki well.
Smaller doesn't mean weaker.

lines.zh: 你看着我这副样子想笑？
lines.en: You look like you want to laugh at me.
You'll understand once I move.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下太快，你没看清吧。
lines.en: Too fast just now, wasn't it?
Don't judge me by my height.
I can go faster than this.

lines.zh: 你的站姿让我想起一个人。
lines.en: Your stance reminds me of someone.
I don't like delays; let's go.
Ready to take it?
The feel of this body is odd.
When I get serious, I change.
If you want to test me, do it now.

lines.zh: 气往上走了，你感觉到了吗？
lines.en: The ki is rising. Feel it?
This fist is not light.
Don't back too far; I'm quick.
The pain pushes me back half a block.
This body feels hits more sharply.
Your fist is quick.
I grin and steady my ki.
That nearly knocked me off balance.

lines.zh: 我不躲这一下，为了看清。
lines.en: I took it to see it clearly.
My shoulder went numb for a moment.
This sting is just a warm-up.
Smaller body, quicker hunger.
After we fight, I'll eat. Promise.
Hold it steady, don't spill.
One bite won't stop my fists.
This body needs more food.
Wait until this match ends.
Wonder if I can take it with me.
Someone told me this is tasty.
You hit my aura shell.
I can block even while hovering.

lines.zh: 你撞过来时我退了半格。
lines.en: I gave half a block when you charged.
Didn't hurt you, did I?
Let's pass; don't tangle.

lines.zh: 这身体太轻，容易被撞歪。
lines.en: This body is light and gets knocked aside.
You can't step on my feet.
I skim low; if I can't dodge, we collide.
I felt that one clearly.
Do it again and I won't give way.
Given this state, let's skip it.
Wait until I'm back to normal.
This body isn't suited to it.
My mind is only on getting stronger.
Maybe wait till I recover.
I can't bring myself to say such things.
Let's finish this fight first.
I haven't figured this body out.
Don't tease me.
Another day, really.
I caught it in midair.
If it fell, it'd be gone.
This fits inside my gi.
Let me see whose it is.
Small and easy to carry.
I toss it; not heavy.
Don't let the wind take it.
This is just what I lacked.
I'll set it on the ground for you.
I can use this.

lines.zh: 这股气，隔着山我也认得。
lines.en: I'd know that ki across a mountain.
Charging up for a dash.
Let me build my ki first.
The target is you; no doubt.
This one has to break your guard.
I've picked your shoulder.
Good timing; I was itching for this.
Don't show me your back.
Three moves and I'll have you figured.
Ki is gathered in my palm.
I don't strike unless I mean it.
Close enough now.
You're standing exactly where I want.
I've taken the initiative.
My speed will deceive you.
Come on, don't dawdle.
I circle you and gain height.
You're looking for me; I'm above.

lines.zh: 你的拳打不到这个角度。
lines.en: Your fists can't reach this angle.
I'm timing the gaps between your moves.
Ki spins in my palm.
Watching your feet is enough.
You leave a gap when you turn.
This is exactly the range I want.
Come closer and I drop on you.
No rush; the ki isn't full yet.
Your wind-up is too obvious.
I come from above.
Watch my left fist.
This smaller body is actually more agile.
I've kept one move back.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸告诉我你要退。
lines.en: Your breath tells me you'll retreat.
I keep you from getting airborne.
One more circle and I've seen it all.
Charged dash!
Super God Fist; catch it.
Aerial combo; don't fall.
This kick comes from above.
My fist wind tears the ground.

lines.zh: 你挡住第一下，还有第二下。
lines.en: You blocked the first; here's the second.
Three hits in a row.
My knife hand cuts your shoulder.
You're knocked off your feet.
If you can't match the speed, don't block.
That was half my strength.
Try another fist.

lines.zh: 你退的路线我早猜到了。
lines.en: I guessed your retreat path.
The Kamehameha hasn't come out yet.
Close in, I'm even more comfortable.
Plant your feet for the next one.
The air here is different.
I settle half a block above ground.
The ki hasn't fully connected yet.
Who called me here?
Let me see what world this is.
The weight of this body is strange.
Let me test my limbs.
The clouds move fast up there.
There's strong ki nearby.
No transformation yet, but this is enough.
Wind lifts the dust.
Get steady first.
Haven't been this light in ages.
I hear someone shouting.
Lift the aura a little.
This trip looks interesting.
I'll hover a moment first.
Fire caught my arm; the skin curls.
I fell from height and made a crater.
I can't last long underwater.
The blast flipped me over in midair.
Something lodged in my leg.
That spellwork seeped into my ki.
Hunger makes my hover wobble.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我整条手臂发麻。
lines.en: Lightning fell; my whole arm went numb.
Even the air beneath me is gone.
